projectDescription: A free, open-source browser tank arcade — no registration required — featuring 7 hulls, 9 turrets, 91 maps, smart bots, and peer-to-peer multiplayer via WebRTC, deployable as a Cloudflare Worker or self-hosted with Bun + Redis.
keyFeatures: No registration or pay-to-win — everything unlocked from the first second
7 hulls (Wasp, Hornet, Hunter, Viking, Dictator, Titan, Mammoth) and 9 turrets
5 battle modes: Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Assault, Explore
91 maps with summer and winter variants, open from the start
Peer-to-peer WebRTC full-mesh multiplayer (up to 12 tanks per room)
Smart AI bots with pathfinding, mode-aware tactics, and per-difficulty tuning
PWA installable on mobile — touch, keyboard, and gamepad support
Two interchangeable backends: Cloudflare Workers (edge) and Bun + Redis (self-hosted)
Host migration, reconnect/rejoin, and TURN relay out of the box
Free unlimited supplies (repair, armour, damage, nitro, nuclear) with shared cooldowns
publicApiSurface: WS /ws/room/:id — signalling socket (join, signal, listing, leave, welcome, peerJoined, peerLeft, hostChanged, error)
GET /assets/* — game assets (maps, hulls, turrets, textures, sounds)
